messages:
jamal: Quick heads up — I opened PR #4821 to add a staging overlay that wires a new service account to the secrets path we discussed. Can someone eyeball gating configs before we promote?

alex: Thanks — linking it here: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4821 :eyes:

maria: Reposting the change summary from the PR: adds k8s rolebinding and updates terraform var for secrets path. Small terraform change in modules/secrets: `secrets_path = "/staging/apps/ci-service"`

jamal: exact — also added a kube manifest patch to mount the secret as env. snippet:
```yaml
# overlays/staging/kustomize/patches/sa-secret-patch.yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ServiceAccount
metadata:
  name: ci-service-sa
---
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: ci-service
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      serviceAccountName: ci-service-sa
      containers:
      - name: app
        envFrom:
        - secretRef:
            name: ci-service-credentials
```

devops-chris: Quick comment — terraform plan showed IAM role already exists in prod overlay, staging will create a new role with shorter name. Are we okay with name divergence? Might affect cross-env scripts.

alex: I think shorter name is fine for staging but we should add an alias in terraform to keep lookup stable. pinging @sre-oncall for infra policy check.

sre-oncall: Looks fine from a permissions perspective. Only ask: will this secret rotation use SSE-KMS in Secrets Manager? If yes, we need the KMS key ARN in the overlay or it will fail on apply.

jamal: Yes SSE-KMS, added param `kms_key_arn = var.staging_kms_arn` in PR. I left prod KMS untouched.

maria: CI run started for the branch. If plan looks clean we can mark for canary promote. Also we should gate with the release job that ensures overlay image pinning is present.

ci-bot: CI Pipeline #4821 — plan: SUCCESS, tests: 5/5 passed, terraform-diff: no destructive changes detected. (build 3421) :white_check_mark:

devops-chris: Nice. For canary, can we do a namespace-only promote to `staging-canary` first? That way we validate secret mount without touching prod overlays.

alex: Agree. Add a `canary_branch` label and we can promote via the promote script: `scripts/promote-overlay --env staging --branch staging-canary`. I left a tiny README update in the PR describing that.

jamal: I'll open the canary branch after merge and coordinate the promote window. Plan to do canary tomorrow 09:30 PST.

sre-oncall: Confirmed — I'll be reachable during canary. If anything fails, we roll back via the overlay revert PR flow.

maria: LGTM from product-ops side — no config changes needed on the app level.

alex: Approved the PR and added alias suggestion as a follow-up issue (#4822).

jamal: Thanks all — merging now. Will post promote status in #eng-infra once canary is up. :rocket:
